title: Knowledge Channel turns over TV sets, learning tools to QC schools, child development centers
summary: The Knowledge Channel Foundation Inc. (KCFI), in partnership with Bloomberry Cultural Foundation, has turned over television sets and learning resources to Quezon City Child Development Centers.
